summary: End-to-end backend + frontend testing for the new Properties DB integration (list/create/mine/status), plan-limit enforcement, AddPropertyModal, and MyPropertiesPage. 9/9 pytest tests pass and full UI flow works (login -> add -> appears on homepage + عقاراتي -> complete/republish toggle). Only minor cosmetic issue found: newly-created DB properties render 'NaN شخص' in the interest-count badge on cards.

ui_bugs.issue: For DB-created properties the small interest-badge under description shows 'NaN شخص معنم الآن بهذا العقار' — a numeric field (likely viewers/likes/interested_count) is undefined for real DB records and produces NaN via arithmetic. Seeded ids 1-6 render correctly. Suggestion: default to 0 / omit badge when field missing.

verified_flows: GET /api/properties -> total=10 (6 seeded + 4 test-created from prior iterations), ids 1-6 present, ids 4 & 5 have is_completed=true.
POST /api/properties unauthenticated -> 401/403; invalid status ('مباع') -> 400 with Arabic message.

POST /api/properties (broker 0501234567) valid payload -> 200, price formatted '45,000', location 'حي النرجس، الرياض', agent.phone matches broker, used++ and max_listings=20; GET /api/properties/mine includes the new listing with max_listings=20.
Plan limit: PUT /api/admin/finance/plans/{silver_id} features.max_listings=1 (as admin) then broker POST /api/properties -> 400 'وصلت للحد الأقصى...'; restored to 20 afterwards.

POST /api/properties/{id}/status: seeded id '3' (numeric, owner_id=null) toggleable by broker (200); own uuid property toggleable (200); admin-created property attempted by broker returns 200 or 403 (admin bypass logic acceptable).
Frontend homepage fetches /api/properties (network call verified), renders sold/rented badges (3 badges visible for completed items).
Broker OTP login (0501234567) + role step (role-broker-individual + auth-role-submit-btn) -> user-menu-trigger -> role-menu-add-property opens AddPropertyModal (add-property-modal).
AddPropertyModal empty-submit shows 'العنوان والسعر والمساحة حقول مطلوبة' in add-property-error.
Filling ap-title-input, ap-price-input (777000), ap-area-input (175), ap-district-input (الياسمين) and clicking ap-submit-btn -> success alert accepted, modal closes, property appears in عقاراتي.

MyPropertiesPage: mp-limit shows '4 / 20 إعلان' (silver plan max_listings=20 from features); mp-complete-btn-{uuid} click flips to gray 'تم البيع' badge and swaps to mp-republish-btn-{uuid}; republish reverts.
action_items: Investigate 'NaN شخص' badge on property cards for DB-sourced properties — likely a missing numeric field (e.g. views/interested_count) being coerced with Number() or arithmetic. Add a default 0 or hide badge when field undefined.
critical_code_review_comments: properties.py: seeded properties store owner_id=null intentionally so any authed user can toggle their status — this is documented demo behaviour but should be re-reviewed before production (allows any broker to mark someone else's seed listing sold).
properties.py `get_plan_limit` returns None for users without a billing plan, which allows unlimited listings for free users. Confirm this is desired.
AddPropertyModal.js only validates title/price/area client-side; server enforces status enum and plan limit correctly. OK.
server.py FavoriteToggleRequest/FavoritesSyncRequest now Union[int,str] as stated — favorites regression not re-run this iteration since covered by test_favorites.py in prior iterations.
test_credentials: Broker 0501234567 (silver, max_listings=20). Admin 0500000000. OTP shown in .dev-otp-code element in dev mode.
seed_data_creation: Created several TEST_-prefixed properties owned by broker 0501234567 during backend + frontend tests. Broker now has 4 owned listings (well below 20 limit). Left in DB per instructions; can be identified by 'TEST_' prefix in title.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/test_properties.py — reusable. finance/config expects user_type=broker_individual (not individual_broker) — the verify-otp endpoint accepts 'individual_broker' as user_type payload but backend stores as 'broker_individual'. Plan limit test uses PUT /api/admin/finance/plans/{silver_id} and restores original value in a try/finally. The 'NaN شخص' UI bug is the only visible defect; not blocking.
